name: decky-ai-usage
description: Show AI coding assistant usage quotas in the Decky Quick Access menu

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf out && mkdir -p out/ai-usage && cp -r dist main.py package.json plugin.json README.md out/ai-usage/ && rm -f out/ai-usage/dist/*.map && cd out && zip -qr ai-usage.zip ai-usage
